description:
Changed North Carolina (NC) statutes, by effective date, observation or session year.

source="effective" answers "what took effect on 1 October" from ncleg's own effective
dates — use it for that, and bound a single day with since=until. It looks FORWARD too,
so it also answers "what takes effect next quarter".

source="statutory" is the legislature's record from history notes, back to the 1800s,
dated by year. source="observed" is only when this database saw text change — ncleg's
publishing schedule, not the law's, and no substitute for effective dates.

"both" returns statutory + observed. For one section use amendment_history.
name: recent_law_changes
title: Recently changed North Carolina (NC) statutes
